The test image shows extremely small, densely scattered reddish-orange spots uniformly covering green soybean leaflets with slight yellowing. This matches Soybean_rust (Dise_74) most closely — same spot size, density, color (reddish-orange with yellow halos), and background leaf color. Cercospora could be a distant second but its spots are more reddish-purple and tend toward a bronzed/leathery appearance as they coalesce.
